description: 🏆Winning Project | ModelGate is a contract-aware AI control plane that ingests customer contracts, extracts SLA/privacy/routing constraints, and generates an OpenAI-compatible endpoint that automatically routes every request to the optimal model. Simple queries go to cheap models. Complex queries go to premium ones.
